additional_concerns: Paragraph 10 and footnote 1 retain ultimate responsibility despite outsourcing. They do not expressly establish a complete conjunctive test of retained authority, supervisory conduct and satisfactory outcomes. That operational interpretation needs justification before formalization.

No assessment period, incident severity threshold, remediation rule or complete adequacy standard is supplied. Actual authority, supervision, operational performance and ownership-record evidence are also absent. Missing evidence cannot automatically produce a false REQUIREMENT_SATISFIED result.

Footnote 1 references Part A of the Appendix to the Tokenised Securities Circular where applicable. That Appendix, the complete paragraphs 10–13 and footnote 2 are not supplied; their relevant content and applicability remain unresolved.

Paragraphs 15 and 16 separately condition obtaining third-party audit or verification and a satisfactory legal opinion on SFC request. Neither establishes an unconditional prerequisite to substantive fulfillment of paragraph 10.

Code 6.8 permits register maintenance by specified parties, including a trustee-appointed person; this does not displace the Product Provider's retained responsibility. The intermediary responsibility provision likewise preserves responsibility despite outsourcing within its own stated scope.
No executable meaning exists for this candidate. Retrieval results and the unsupported structural check establish neither legal sufficiency nor executable fidelity.
